visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark brown hair styled in double buns and a red polka-dot Minnie Mouse bow headband sits in a white bathtub overflowing with thick white foam. She wears a peach-colored sleeveless top. Behind her, a wall of green marble and a glass window are visible. She speaks animatedly with a wide smile and expressive facial movements. (2) The camera angle shifts to a second woman with short blonde hair and a white headband sitting in the same bubble-filled tub. She wears a white halter bikini and gestures with her hands while talking. To her right, a portion of a third woman in a teal bikini is visible. (3) A medium shot shows the woman in the teal bikini holding a gold-colored smartphone. She has long dark hair and is looking towards the blonde woman while talking. Foam covers their bodies up to the chest. The lighting is bright and clinical, typical of a modern indoor spa or bathroom setting. (4) A close-up focus on the woman in the teal bikini as she smiles and continues the conversation. Large pink and blue graphic text overlays appear on the screen, synchronized with her speech. The background green marble wall remains the primary setting element, providing a consistent high-end atmosphere. (5) The blonde woman speaks again, her expression shifting from serious to smiling. A large white variety-show style text box with black text appears briefly in the center of the frame, highlighting the comedic emphasis of her words against the backdrop of white bubbles. (6) A game segment begins where the blonde woman and the woman in the teal bikini are blindfolded with pink masks featuring cartoon pig faces. The first woman in the peach top stands behind them, laughing and pointing directly at the woman in the teal bikini. (7) The woman in the peach top smashes a white plate filled with thick white foam onto the chest area of the blindfolded woman in the teal bikini. Everyone laughs hysterically as the foam splatters widely across her skin, bikini, and the surrounding water. (8) The video cuts to a final graphic screen with a light blue background decorated with multiple fried egg illustrations. Large white and green text provides specific instructions on how to find the full version of the video on a social media platform.
